note: DRAFT for Eli to edit (run FIRE statuses and the life timeline, Nov 27 2026, Part 1). The words shown when a FIRE status is reached: what changed, and the options it opens. Both apps read this one file (the web app loads it; node tools/game_statuses_build.mjs copies it into game/core/statuses.js). Each option links to a tool that exists: web is a page or a route of the web app, game is an action of the game's menu. An option is something to look at. It never changes the next step by itself.
heading: Options this opens
stay: Your next step stays the same. These are options.

Coast.title: You can stop sprinting
Coast.changed: What you have invested can grow to your FI number by the age you set, with nothing more added. From here, saving is a choice about how soon, not a race.

options.t: Lower what you put toward retirement
options.why: Growth alone carries you to your number. What you add now only moves the date sooner.

options.t: Look at lower-paid work you like more
options.why: Your pay only has to cover today's bills, not tomorrow's.
Money that went to retirement can go to a home, a trip or a break.

Lean.title: You reached Lean FI
Lean.changed: Your investments can pay for your needs for good: food, housing and transportation. Work now pays for everything else.

options.why: A regular investment account is money you can reach before 59 and a half.

options.t: Work is optional on a lean budget
options.why: See how long your money lasts if the paycheck stopped and you lived on needs only.

options.t: Try a break from work on paper
options.why: A few months off, a sabbatical or a slower job, priced before you choose.

Barista.title: You reached Barista FI
Barista.changed: Part-time work you like, plus your investments, can pay for the life you live today. Full-time work is a choice.

options.t: Fill the HSA and build the health-cover bridge
options.why: Health insurance is the cost part-time pay has to carry. It is added to your number unless you tap that the part-time job covers it.

options.t: Look at part-time work that covers your costs
options.why: Compare the pay, the hours and the health cover of two jobs side by side.

options.t: Try the move to part-time on paper
options.why: The month the pay changes, the tripwires and a plan B.

FI.title: You reached FI
FI.changed: Your investments can pay for the life you live today, for good. Work is optional.

options.t: See how you would take money out
options.why: Which account first, and how much comes out with no federal tax.
Your date and your number if markets are slow or you take out more.

options.t: Choose when your net worth should peak
options.why: Money is for living. See when to start spending it down.

Chubby.title: You reached Chubby FI
Chubby.changed: Your investments can pay for today's life with some room: half of your Fat list.

options.why: Pick which extras on your Fat list start now.
Cleaning or childcare buys back hours. See which tasks to hand off.
Set a giving rate, or plan one larger gift.

Fat.title: You reached Fat FI
Fat.changed: Your investments can pay for today's life plus every extra on your Fat list.

options.why: Every extra on your Fat list is paid for. Check that the list is still the life you want.
Cleaning or childcare buys back hours. See which tasks to hand off.

options.t: Give while you can see it
options.why: Set a giving rate, bunch gifts, or plan what goes to your people.
